title: Krohn–Rhodes decomposition of finite monoids into aperiodic and simple-group factors
summary: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the Krohn–Rhodes prime decomposition theorem for finite monoids, in a form with aperiodic factors: every finite monoid M divides an iterated wreath product of finite monoids, each of which is aperiodic or a simple group, and every simple group among the factors divides M. The proof follows the local-divisor proof of Diekert, Kufleitner and Steinberg.
